description: An OCCURS DEPENDING ON table under the sliding reading, in a variable-length dataset: a header whose count governs the run of detail records that follows it, and two detail records whose tables hold a different number of occurrences, each with an alphanumeric item behind the table that only stays in place if the table was read at the length its own count states.
source: docs/ir/SPEC.md, "A variable record is a sum with a variable term", "An item after a table slides, and the other reading is a fixed table", "A count is in hand before the extent it decides", "A variable record does not fit a fixed-length dataset", "The automaton remembers, in registers" and "Appendix: A counted run, as nodes"; docs/layout/SPEC.md, "The OCCURS DEPENDING ON reading is one statement per layout" and "Two operators read a value, and they are the automaton's memory"; the record descriptor word is batch-rdw's, from docs/ir/SPEC.md, "Where framing is consumed, and where it is emitted"; the zoned and alphanumeric bytes are cobol-go codec/SPEC.md, "Storage Widths" and "Group items, OCCURS, and SYNCHRONIZED"
